Name: Sennibun Plushies
Author: KingMadapples
Description:
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/zvyCr6zx/about.png[/img]﻿[quote]﻿Have you ever wanted a toasted, cozy Strange Sennibun hanging out in your living room? Do you ever feel like you're just not...Senough? Well, fear not! Here's your daily dose of dopamine distilled in a delightful, delicate little package. In this two for one special, you receive two pieces of furniture in one mod! The two pieces of furniture are labeled "Senough Plush" and "Strange Sennibun Plush" in the Furniture Catalogue.[/quote]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/Prg5KcBd/special-thanks.png[/img][quote][i]﻿Special Thanks to Pokeinalover for the fan art that inspired this, 7thAxis for allowing me to make it and the rest of the East Scarp server for supporting me, and Aday494 for the  [/i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19918]Sennibun Plushies - Traduccion espanol at Stardew Valley Nexus - Mods and community (nexusmods.com)[/url][/quote]

Downloads.Description: All you need aside from the Furniture Catalogue
